citation: Bosserelle, C., Lane, E. and Harang, A. (2021). BG-Flood: A GPU adaptive, open-source, general inundation hazard model. Australasian Coasts & Ports 2021. https://github.com/CyprienBosserelle/BG_Flood
description: BG-Flood is the developer team's shallow-water inundation model with GPU acceleration and adaptive spatial resolution. It contains a block-uniform quadtree solver inspired by Basilisk and simulations for rainfall, rivers, storm surge and tsunami flooding. A text parameter file defines a run, with topographic and forcing information supplied for the selected domain; outputs describe simulated hydrodynamic conditions and inundation. Spatial detail follows the variable-resolution grid and time coverage follows the event. GPL-3.0 source is free, with Windows binaries and compilation guidance for Linux and macOS. A limitation is that the README lists culverts and a groundwater module as ongoing development, not established features. The model supports flood-defence design and exposure studies. TELEMAC-MASCARET (model-telemac-mascaret) provides related hydraulic modelling. The repository cites a 2021 methods paper and later real-world studies; their data packages require separate checks.
name: BG-Flood inundation model
